Which statement about silicon(IV) oxide is correct?
A
It contains silicon ions and oxide ions arranged in a giant lattice.
B
It is used in electrical circuits because it can conduct electricity.
C
Its bonds each contain one shared pair of electrons.
D
Its atoms are arranged in the same way as the atoms in graphite.

options.label: A
options.text: It contains silicon ions and oxide ions arranged in a giant lattice.

options.label: B
options.text: It is used in electrical circuits because it can conduct electricity.

options.label: C
options.text: Its bonds each contain one shared pair of electrons.

options.label: D
options.text: Its atoms are arranged in the same way as the atoms in graphite.
